BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to local option transportation revenue; and addinga new section to chapter 36.57A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.57A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governing body of a public transportation benefit arealocated in a county with a population of seven hundred thousand or morethat also contains a city with a population of seventyfive thousand ormore operating a transit system pursuant to chapter 35.95 RCW may, forthe sole purpose of providing funds for the operation, maintenance, orcapital needs of public transportation systems, submit an authorizingproposition to the voters and, if approved by a majority of personsvoting on the proposition, impose a local motor vehicle excise taxunder chapter 82.44 RCW of up to one percent annually on the value ofevery motor vehicle registered to a person residing within the county. (2) The governing body of a public transportation benefit areaimposing a local motor vehicle excise tax under this section mustcontract, before imposition of the tax, administration and collection p. 1 HB 1953to the department of licensing, as appropriate, which must deduct anamount, as provided by contract, for administration and collectionexpenses incurred by the department.
